role: Gate: replays the oracle's ProjectileProbe dump (items, orbs, arrows, snowballs, eggs, ender pearls, potions, large and small fireballs spawned with the vanilla constructor draws) through csrc/engine/item_entity.c and projectile.c, including chicken hatching from eggs, and compares every entity field per tick.

structs.name: splitref
structs.java: one Det split stream (determinize.sh static RNG name) per role

structs.name: ref
structs.java: the oracle's Det start.txt/end.txt snapshot (netherite.oracle.Det: world seed, per-role nextId, seeder/math digests, split streams)

notes: Test harness, built with -Dmain=gate_test_main behind tests/input_guard.c; not linked into the product and never on the tick path. make -C csrc test runs it on every directory under out/java/projectiles. Native calls: ie_init, ie_added_to_world, ie_tick, ie_free (csrc/engine/item_entity.h; projectile_update in projectile.c is reached through ie_tick), an_init, an_tick_one, an_egg_chicken (living.h), entity_init/entity_set_size/entity_set_position, det_* including the constructor draws (Math.random, nextGaussian/nextBoolean) replayed per kind. ie_fizz_stub and ie_attack_stub stand in for hooks. Skips a dump whose kind is not projectiles. In memslot.sh's big pool. Oracle side: oracle/harness/netherite/oracle/ProjectileProbe.java. Recordings: out/java/projectiles/proj-2, proj-42, eggs2-2, eggs2-42.
